original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹阿韦尔东县一名女子杀害婆婆
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹北加扎勒河州阿韦尔东县一名22岁女子因争执用刀刺死其47岁婆婆，随后被警方逮捕并关押于瓦尼乔克中央监狱。当地官员称死者事发时处于醉酒状态，有机构将案件归因于干旱导致的粮食短缺与贫困压力。目前信息为单一来源。

location.site: 马德霍尔帕亚姆阿布地区
location.raw_text: Aweil East County in Northern Bahr El Ghazal State, Madhol Payam's Abu area

key_facts.fact: 一名22岁女子在阿韦尔东县刺死其47岁婆婆后被捕
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A 22-year-old woman has been arrested after stabbing her mother-in-law to death on Sunday morning in Aweil East County in Northern Bahr El Ghazal State

key_facts.fact: 嫌疑人被南苏丹国家警察局逮捕并关押于瓦尼乔克中央监狱
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the suspect was apprehended by the South Sudan National Police Service (SSNPS) and taken to Wanyjok Central Prison

key_facts.fact: 当地官员称死者事发时处于醉酒状态，争执持续两天后于第三天被杀
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The deceased, who was under the influence of alcohol, fought the suspected killer for two consecutive days and on the third day, she was killed

key_facts.fact: 有机构将此类案件归因于干旱与长期旱情导致的粮食不足、贫困和家庭压力
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Such incidents are happening because people have been cultivating their crops, but the drought and long dry spell have limited food production this agricultural season

uncertainties: 案件目前为单一来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
嫌疑人是否已被正式起诉或定罪尚未证实
